text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Morocco's telecommunications sector needs up to 10 years to be upgraded. Draft law on privatisation of sector is expected to be approved by parliament soon.
- Interior minister Driss Basri examines situation in universities after recent disturbances in Casablanca.
- Moroccan interior ministry is expected to purchase 60,000 transparent ballot boxes for legislative elections scheduled for the second half of 1997.
- Prosecutor in Casablanca court demands five-year jail term for three Moslem students accused of disturbing public order.
